articles.summary: INDIANAPOLIS, Oct. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Kite Realty Group (NYSE: KRG) announced today that it will release financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, before the market opens on Friday, October 30, 2026. KRG will conduct a conference call to discuss its financial results on Friday, October 30, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time. articles.summary: INDIANAPOLIS, Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Kite Realty Group (NYSE: KRG), a premier owner and operator of high-quality, open-air grocery-anchored shopping centers and vibrant mixed-use assets, reported today its operating results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. For the quarters ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, net loss attributable to common shareholders was $13.3 million, or $0.07 per diluted share, compared to $16.2 million, or $0.07 per diluted share, respectively. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, net income attributable to common shareholders was $159.4 million, or $0.78 per diluted share, compared to $117.8 million, or $0.54 per diluted share, respectively.
